thread:
Maria Chen: Quick thread to lock down DP invite criteria for Private Deploy v2. We want 6-8 partners, mixed industries, staggered starts. Need a short, defensible rubric and clear intake gating.
Liam Foster: Nice. Suggest we keep it to 4 scored axes + 2 binary gates so screening is fast.
Priya Singh: Agree. Proposed axes: product fit, infra readiness, feedback fidelity, and business leverage. Keep scores 1-5.
Noah Kim: For infra readiness, add a binary 'can provide ephemeral test data' checkbox. If no, very low priority.
Claire Dubois: Feedback fidelity = assigned reviewer + weekly sync commit. Make that explicit in intake.
Maria Chen: Draft weights: product fit 30%, infra readiness 25%, feedback fidelity 25%, business leverage 20%. Binary gates: pilot window <=45 days and no blocking legal terms.
Liam Foster: Also add a quick capacity check: partner must designate at least one engineer and one product contact for the pilot. Treat as a gate.
Priya Singh: For recruitment copy: keep it short. Example: "6-week private beta + 2w integration. Weekly async reports + biweekly deep-dive. Incentive: $4k infra credit or co-marketing."
Noah Kim: Ops: we'll need a fallback lighter model for single-GPU customers. I can sketch a 'single-GPU profile' doc.
Claire Dubois: Success metrics proposal: 
- Partner engagement >= 70% of scheduled touchpoints
- >=8 unique actionable items per partner in first 6 weeks
- One pilot convert to paid/reserved within 120 days
- No blocker-level SLO breach related to integration during pilot

Maria Chen: Love it. Add monthly eval harness (20-40 prompts) that partners run; automated diffs flag regressions.
Liam Foster: Intake form fields: company, primary use case, expected QPS, infra (k8s/VMs/GPU), legal notes, commitment checkboxes. Keep it single page.
Priya Singh: We'll include a simple scoring sheet and ask internal stakeholders to nominate 3 seeds. Then we run the rubric and invite top 8.
Noah Kim: I'll add monitoring tags and an alert channel for each partner. infra-bot: created channel #dp-1823459999-monitoring (auto).
Claire Dubois: Who owns the gating call? Product PM to greenlight, Eng to validate infra, Legal to confirm addendum.
Maria Chen: Owners: PM lead (Priya) for invites, Eng lead (Noah) for infra runbooks, Ops (Liam) for on-call rules. We'll reconvene Tue 10am to review seed list and intake.
Liam Foster: I'll pull candidate list and score with the template.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the outreach message and the intake form today.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Please keep updates here; short status pings only. :rocket:
